Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS)
Health Emergency Operation Center & Control Room
Press Release — Dengue
Date: 29 September 2026

In the last 24 hours (from 8 am on 28 September to 8 am on 29 September 2026), 882 new dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country. Among them, Dhaka North City Corporation 120, Dhaka South City Corporation 150, Dhaka division (excluding city corporations) 231, Chattogram division 98, Khulna division 70, Rajshahi division 50, Rangpur division 10, Mymensingh division 40, Barishal division 110 and Sylhet division 3.

During this period, 3 people died of dengue: Dhaka South City Corporation 2, Barishal division 1.

So far this year, a total of 77,672 dengue patients have been admitted to hospitals and 239 people have died. Of them, Dhaka South City Corporation 18,450 and Dhaka North City Corporation 12,311.

Currently 3,020 patients are under treatment in hospitals across the country.
